description: Find same-language publisher expressions for one EU act. Each entry has an exact expression ID, source hash and a consolidation marker or as-adopted label. These markers identify text; they do not prove when it applied. Pass a returned expression ID to lookup_provision to read that exact text. Use asAt only when the source carries an explicit validity window.

sourceLang.description: Optional held three-letter EU source language, e.g. fra or ita.

work.description: ELI URI of the instrument, e.g. 'http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1994/23' (UK VAT Act 1994) or 'http://data.europa.eu/eli/dir/2006/112/oj' (EU VAT Directive).

name: list_work_versions

outputSchema.description: The JSON response from the corresponding Lexiara API route.

title: List held official EU text versions
